1.
Providers of high
-
risk AI systems shall keep the logs, referred to in
Article 12(1),
automatically generated by their high
-
risk AI systems, to the extent such logs are under

for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the hig
h
-
risk AI system, of at least 6

2.
Providers that are financial institutions subject to requirements regarding their inter
nal
governance, arrangements or processes under Union financial services legislation shall
maintain the logs automatically generated by their high
-
risk AI systems as part of the
documentation kept under the relevant financial service legislation.
